## Description

**What**: Author plugins/dso/docs/DETECTION-SCHEMA.md and upgrade plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md to v2; reference both from CLAUDE.md.
**Why**: Establishes the contract that all downstream stories depend on (namespaced tag convention, axis enum, legacy compound preservation, query patterns, edge-case rules).
**Scope**:
- IN: DETECTION-SCHEMA.md (axes, tag convention, legacy-compound preservation, whitespace strip, empty->unknown, trailing-empty strip, multi-stack reject, detector authoring guide); CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md v2 (stack and commands.* schemas, v1->v2 migration table, semicolon delimiter); CLAUDE.md cross-link.
- OUT: Detector implementations (other stories); `commands.*` semicolon parsing implementation (separate story).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, plugins/dso/docs/DETECTION-SCHEMA.md exists and documents the namespaced flat-array schema, axis enum, legacy-compound preservation rule, whitespace/empty/trailing-empty/multi-stack edge cases, and detector authoring guide ← Satisfies: "Detector author can implement a new detector using only the published contract"
- When complete, plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md is v2 with `stack` and `commands.*` schemas plus v1->v2 migration table ← Satisfies: "Detector author can implement a new detector using only the published contract"
- When complete, CLAUDE.md links to both docs from its architecture section ← Satisfies: "Detector author can implement a new detector using only the published contract"
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic (doc-content checks where applicable; structural references)

## Considerations
- [Maintainability] Cross-cutting reference doc — every other story consumes this; keep schema stable across the epic
- [Testing] Schema doc must include explicit anti-patterns section (matches check-no-stack-case.sh self-exclusion)

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
